sloka: भ्रात्रा हि मयि संन्यासो निक्षिप्त: सौहृदादयम् ।तमिमं पालयिष्यामि राघवागमनं प्रति ॥ २.११५.१७॥
transliteration: bhrātrā hi mayi saṁnyāso nikṣipta: sauhṛdādayam ।tamimaṁ pālayiṣyāmi rāghavāgamanaṁ prati ॥ 2.115.17॥

translations.english: This kingdom has been given me by my brother out of affection as a trust. I shall safeguard it until Rama's return.
